name: Step sequencer
doc: Beat-synced step sequencer: walks `pattern` (values 0..1, one per step) on the grid, with optional glide; gate fires on every step whose value is above 0.

gate.doc: 1 on the first tick of a step with a value > 0

pattern.doc: step values 0..1, space separated; the step count is its length

glide.doc: fraction of a step spent sliding from the previous value
